banned_textures._comment: Never shipped (identifiable photos / band images / unknown provenance); presets that sample one are excluded.

milkdrop_textures._comment: The textures MilkDrop 2 itself installed; shipped as the sampler_randNN pool.

brightness._comment: sat = mean fraction of pixels with a channel >= 250 over frames from..frames; luma = mean Rec.601 luma. sat > exclude_sat_above with luma >= exclude_min_luma is excluded (0 = sat alone decides; a saturated pure colour also counts), else listed for review above review_sat_above.

excluded_presets._comment: Excluded by hand, with the reason; ids are normalised pack ids.
